spec.title: Remove rubber-stamp Q&A questions from festina-scope and festina-create
spec.context: festina-scope asks 3 questions during technical Q&A that users always answer with the default (dependencies: "None", patterns: "Yes", constraints: "None"). festina-create asks for priority confirmation (always "Medium"), label confirmation when auto-detected (always "Yes"), and engineering doc type when no docs match (always "None needed"). These violate the "propose, don't interrogate" principle and add friction without value. Task #016 already removed 14 similar confirmations — this extends that treatment to the remaining ~6 rubber-stamp questions.

in-scope.item: Remove 3 AskUserQuestion calls from festina-scope conduct_qa_dialogue step (dependencies, patterns, constraints)
Remove priority AskUserQuestion from festina-create get_priority step — default to "medium"
Remove label confirmation AskUserQuestion from festina-create determine_label step when auto-detected
Remove engineering doc type AskUserQuestion from festina-create search_engineering_docs step when no match — default to "none"
Replace each removed question with an output statement declaring the auto-decision
Preserve the ability for users to volunteer overrides during Q&A

out-of-scope.item: Other AskUserQuestion calls in festina-scope (approach, files, pitfalls, synthesis — these involve genuine decisions)
The festina-create Q&A dialogue itself (product validation questions remain)
Other skills beyond festina-scope and festina-create
Product or engineering documentation updates (handled by /festina-finalize)

delta.current:
festina-scope conduct_qa_dialogue (lines 620-649) asks 3 sequential questions: "Are there any libraries or dependencies?" with options None/Skip, "Should we follow these patterns?" with options Yes/Modify/Skip, "Are there any technical constraints?" with options None/Skip. Each uses AskUserQuestion and waits for user response.
festina-create get_priority (lines 285-295) asks "What priority should this task have?" with options High/Medium (Recommended)/Low. determine_label (lines 299-307) asks "Auto-detected label: {label}. Is this correct?" with Yes/No when label is auto-detected. search_engineering_docs (lines 168-191) asks "What type of engineering doc should be created?" with System/Pattern/Convention/None needed when no docs match.
delta.changing:
festina-scope: Replace the 3 AskUserQuestion calls with output statements that declare auto-decisions. Dependencies are inferred from research findings and stated. Patterns found during research are auto-included and stated. Constraints from pitfalls/research are stated as decisions.
festina-create: Priority defaults to "medium" with an output statement. Auto-detected label is applied directly with an output statement (only ask when detection fails). Engineering doc type defaults to "none" when no docs match, with stub creation deferred to festina-finalize.
delta.unchanged:
festina-scope: Approach question, files question, pitfall resolution, synthesis approval, web research findings question, boundaries volunteer mechanism, and all other Q&A flow remain unchanged. The "propose, don't interrogate" note stays. Users can still volunteer dependencies/patterns/constraints at any point.
festina-create: Product validation Q&A dialogue, acceptance criteria category probing, doc search and linking, project attachment, stub doc creation, and the label fallback question when detection fails all remain unchanged.

requirements.requirement: The festina-scope conduct_qa_dialogue step shall not ask about dependencies — instead it shall infer dependencies from research findings and state them as an output decision (e.g., "Dependencies: none identified" or "Dependencies: {inferred list}")

The festina-scope conduct_qa_dialogue step shall not ask about patterns — instead it shall auto-include patterns found during research and state them as an output decision (e.g., "Patterns: following {pattern list} from research")

The festina-scope conduct_qa_dialogue step shall not ask about constraints — instead it shall state constraints from pitfalls and research as an output decision (e.g., "Constraints: {list from research}" or "Constraints: none identified")
The festina-create get_priority step shall default to "medium" priority without asking — it shall output the decision as a statement (e.g., "Priority: medium")

The festina-create determine_label step shall auto-apply the detected label without confirmation when keyword detection succeeds — it shall output the decision as a statement (e.g., "Label: refactor (auto-detected)"). The fallback question when detection fails shall remain.

The festina-create search_engineering_docs step shall set engineering to empty/none without asking when no docs match (score < 0.3) — it shall output the decision as a statement. Stub creation is deferred to festina-finalize if needed.

Users shall be able to override any auto-decision by volunteering corrections during Q&A (e.g., "actually use high priority", "we need library X", "don't follow that pattern"), and the skill shall incorporate the override into the final output

pattern.name: Auto-decision output pattern
pattern.description: Replace AskUserQuestion with an output statement that declares the auto-decision. The user sees what was decided and can object during Q&A. Established by task #016 which removed 14 similar confirmations.

Create skill asks for priority, label confirmation, and engineering doc type — all consistently answered with defaults
